snippet.title: Deco Online Origins Official Trailer
snippet.description: Deco Online Origins is a free-to-play 3D MMORPG that puts players deep into the fantastic story of two warring nations, “Millena” and “Rain”. As a legendary swordsman, a fierce archer, or a master of wizardry, players were constantly challenged by the opposing nation and by monsters that lurked around every corner. Notable features included a combo system with hundreds of potential skills and guardian pets that buffed entire guilds.
